title: aster sedifolius subsp. trinervis
intro: Aster sedifolius subsp. trinervis, commonly known as Three-nerved Aster, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including its potential health benefits in reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and enhancing digestion. The therapeutic actions of Aster sedifolius subsp. trinervis include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds, coughs, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
